title: Fix the cart total for an empty cart

spec.summary: An empty cart shows a total of zero instead of an error.
stories: As a shopper, I want an empty cart to total zero, so that the cart page loads.
edgeCases: A cart whose only item was removed totals zero.

criteria.text: The cart's total() returns 0 for a cart with no items.

tasks.title: Total an empty cart
tasks.description: Make total() return 0 when the cart has no items, and add a test that names AC1.
